summary: Unlock the potential of the Circular Economy with our expert-led training. Learn practical strategies to implement sustainable practices in your business.
lede: Circular economy training helps operations, procurement and sustainability professionals identify material losses and plan resource-retention actions. It covers material flow analysis and circularity measurement, waste audits, reuse and reverse logistics, circular procurement, and KPI reporting. Learners also explore recycling and recovery options, circular business models, and implementation roadmaps for practical decisions across operations and supply chains.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to apply circular economy methods in operations, procurement, product planning, or sustainability reporting. Sustainability Managers responsible for circularity strategy and reporting. Operations Managers reducing waste and material loss in daily processes. Procurement Specialists embedding circular criteria into sourcing decisions. Supply Chain Analysts mapping reverse flows and recovery options. Environmental Engineers evaluating material efficiency and recovery pathways. ESG Reporting Professionals translating circular outcomes into disclosures. Product Development Leads applying durability and repair principles. Facilities Managers improving site-level waste segregation and reuse. Manufacturing Supervisors addressing scrap, rework, and recovery streams. Corporate Strategy Analysts shaping circular business model cases.
modules: Material Flow Analysis and Circularity Measurement
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and the willingness to work with simple operational data, including waste figures, procurement categories, or product flow information. A basic understanding of sustainability, operations, or supply chain terminology will help you move faster through the exercises.
